questions.stem: For CH2=CH–CH=CH2 in an approximately planar conformation, identify the continuous sequence of p orbitals and contrast it with CH2=CH–CH2–CH=CH2. Explain which structural feature interrupts that pathway in the second molecule.

answer.summary: In approximately planar CH2=CH-CH=CH2, each of the four sp2 carbons has an unhybridised p orbital and the aligned C1-C2-C3-C4 sequence provides a continuous p pathway. In CH2=CH-CH2-CH=CH2, the central CH2 carbon is locally sp3 and has no unhybridised p orbital available to continue that sequence, so the two double-bond pi systems are separated.

reasoning_route.action: Mark one unhybridised p orbital on each of the four sp2 carbons in the approximately planar conjugated diene.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Each carbon participating in the adjacent double bonds has a p orbital.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

reasoning_route.action: Align the four p orbitals along C1-C2-C3-C4.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Approximate planarity permits neighboring p overlap across the chain.

reasoning_route.action: Inspect the central CH2 in CH2=CH-CH2-CH=CH2 as locally sp3.
reasoning_route.why_valid: A saturated sp3 carbon has no unhybridised p orbital in this introductory model.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

reasoning_route.action: Split the two pi systems at that carbon.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Without an adjacent p orbital at the bridge, the overlap pathway is interrupted.

questions.stem: A student assigns one hybridisation label to an entire molecule. Use propyne and allene to test this procedure and devise a more reliable local procedure. State the electron-domain information and orbital-consistency checks your procedure needs.

answer.summary: A molecule-wide label fails: propyne contains an sp3 methyl carbon and two sp alkyne carbons; allene contains two terminal sp2 carbons and an sp central carbon. A better procedure is atom-local: for each atom, count sigma-bond directions and lone-pair electron domains (a multiple bond is one sigma direction), assign the local introductory geometry/hybridisation, then check that enough correctly oriented unhybridised p orbitals remain for all required pi bonds/delocalisation. Revisit an assignment that fails that orbital check.

reasoning_route.action: Reject molecule-wide labeling by testing propyne and allene atom by atom.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Each molecule contains nonequivalent carbon centres with different local sigma environments.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

reasoning_route.action: For each atom count local sigma directions and lone-pair domains; a multiple bond contributes one sigma direction.
reasoning_route.why_valid: The introductory model describes local sigma geometry.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

reasoning_route.action: Map two, three or four local domains to sp, sp2 or sp3.
reasoning_route.why_valid: These labels describe digonal, trigonal-planar or tetrahedral local sigma frameworks in the simplified model.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

reasoning_route.action: Check leftover unhybridised p orbitals against every required pi bond/delocalisation and orientation.
reasoning_route.why_valid: A local label that cannot support the required pi system is internally inconsistent.
inputs: supplied benchmark stem and prior move

answer.check: Changed check: the procedure must return allene sp2/sp/sp2 and propyne sp3/sp/sp while conserving four carbon basis functions at each site.
